lines: Barbaad na kar
couplets.en: Do not lay us to waste.

lines: Ae ishq, hamein barbaad na kar
couplets.en: O love, do not lay us to waste.

lines: Ae ishq, hamein barbaad na kar
couplets.en: O love, do not lay us to waste.

lines: Ae ishq, na chhed aa aa ke hamein
couplets.en: O love, do not keep coming back to trouble us.

lines: Hum bhoole huon ko yaad na kar
couplets.en: Let us stay forgotten.

lines: Pehle hi bahut naashaad hain hum
couplets.en: We have known sorrow enough already.

lines: Tu aur hamein naashaad na kar
couplets.en: Do not deepen our sorrow.

lines: Qismat ka sitam hi kam nahin kuchh
couplets.en: Fate has been cruel enough.

lines: Ye taaza sitam ijaad na kar
couplets.en: Do not devise another cruelty.

lines: Yun zulm na kar, bedaad na kar
couplets.en: Spare us this cruelty.

lines: Ae ishq, hamein barbaad na kar
couplets.en: O love, do not lay us to waste.

lines: Raaton ko uth uth kar rote hain
couplets.en: Night after night, we rise in tears.

lines: Ro ro ke duaaen karte hain
couplets.en: Through our tears, we pray.

lines: Aankhon mein tasavvur, dil mein khalish
couplets.en: Your image lingers in our eyes and an ache in our hearts.

lines: Sar dhunte hain, aahein bharte hain
couplets.en: We beat our heads and sigh.

lines: Ae ishq, ye kaisa rog laga
couplets.en: O love, what sickness have you brought upon us?

lines: Jeete hain na, zaalim, marte hain
couplets.en: Cruel love, we can neither live nor die.

lines: In khwaabon se yun aazaad na kar
couplets.en: Do not free us from these dreams so readily.

lines: Ae ishq, hamein barbaad na kar
couplets.en: O love, do not lay us to waste.

lines: Jis din se bandha hai dhyaan tera
couplets.en: Since the day our thoughts became bound to you, we have known little peace.

lines: Ghabraaye hue se rehte hain
couplets.en: We live with a quiet unease.

lines: Har waqt tasavvur kar kar ke
couplets.en: We picture you again and again.

lines: Sharmaaye hue se rehte hain
couplets.en: We find ourselves forever blushing.

lines: Kumhlaaye hue phoolon ki tarah
couplets.en: We are like flowers gone limp.

lines: Kumhlaaye hue se rehte hain
couplets.en: We go on withering.

lines: Paamaal na kar, bedaad na kar
couplets.en: Spare us the cruelty of being trampled.

lines: Ae ishq, hamein barbaad na kar
couplets.en: O love, do not lay us to waste.
